name: check
cmd: bash research/track-m/prepare-vendors.sh && bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null && bun run check && bun test core/count*.test.ts core/count-recovery/*.test.ts && bunx commitlint --default-config < replays/commit-message.txt

name: audit-p1-ab
cmd: set -euo pipefail; out=$(mktemp -d); tar -xzf replays/p1-ab.tar.gz -C "$out" ./before/p1/capture.json.gz ./after/p1/capture.json.gz; for side in before after; do echo SIDE=$side; bun research/track-m/audit-lane-b-cost.ts "$out/$side/p1/capture.json.gz" replays/family.json; done

name: audit-p1-ba
cmd: set -euo pipefail; out=$(mktemp -d); tar -xzf replays/p1-ba.tar.gz -C "$out" ./before/p1/capture.json.gz ./after/p1/capture.json.gz; for side in after before; do echo SIDE=$side; bun research/track-m/audit-lane-b-cost.ts "$out/$side/p1/capture.json.gz" replays/family.json; done
